Examples/Descriptions: Claim is submitted for Member number “123”. However member number “123” is not found in payers database. Hence, the claim for this member would not be eligible for payment.

Description: Services requested/performed prior to the effective date of coverage
Examples/Descriptions: The card coverage for a member commences   on 15/09/2010. All services requested/performed before 15/09/2010 will be not be eligible for approval/payment.

Description: Services requested/performed by a non-network provider
Examples/Descriptions: If an authorization request/claim is submitted and the provider is not contracted with a specific plan  or payer on the requested/claimed service dates then such authorization request/claims would not be eligible for approval/payment on direct billing.

Description: Prior approval is required and was not obtained
Examples/Descriptions: Outpatient MRI claim requires pre-approval. However, if no pre-approval was requested or was requested and denied, then such claims would not be eligible for payment.

Description: Services performed are inconsistent with authorized or approved services

Examples/Descriptions: Claim submitted with authorization number which is invalid for the insurance company would not be eligible for payment.

Description: Service(s) is (are) performed outside authorization validity date
Examples/Descriptions: Tonsillectomy is authorized to be carried out between 01/01/2010 and 01/02/2010. However, the claim is submitted with service date 03/02/2010. Hence, such claims would not be eligible for payment.

Description: Claim information is inconsistent with pre-certified/authorized services
Examples/Descriptions: Authorization was obtained for appendectomy while the claim is submitted for inguinal hernia repair using the same authorization number given for the appendectomy.

Description: High alert Drug to drug interaction / Drug combination is contra-indicated
Examples/Descriptions: Example 1: Physician has prescribed Citalopram(SSRI)  while the patient is already on Nardil ( non selective MAOI). The SSR will be rejected as the patient is at risk for a life-threatening complication of the serotonin syndrome. Example 2:  Physician has prescribed cimetidine (tagamet) while patient history shows usage of warfarin (coumadin). This Physician prescription will be rejected owing to high risk drug to drug interaction.

The adjustment code would be applicable If drugs having the same active ingredient or same therapeutic effect in the same form and administration route are prescribed to the patient at the same time by the doctor whether advertently or inadvertently. Example a patient goes to Doctor X and is prescribed Brufen 200 mg tablets for 7 days. After a 3 days the patient goes to Doctor Y for a different condition and is prescribed Dolgit 200 mg tablets at the same time. As both Brufen and Dolgit have the same therapeutic effect / active ingredient in the same form and route this would be considered duplicate therapy.

Prescription exceedes maximum or mininum dosage per day normally based on patient Age and or Weight. This adjustment code would be used if the dosage dispensed / prescribed exceeds this maximum. For Example the Maximum dose per day for Panadol 500 mg is labeled at 4000 mg per day for a patient equal to or above the age of 12. If we encounter requests where the total prescription amount per day exceeds this labeled maximum then these would be flagged with this adjustment code.

Example 1: Non-controlled prescription dated 01.12.2010 and the related authorization request submitted with DOS 10.02.2011. Hence the authorization request will not be eligible for approval as prescription validity for non controlled prescriptions is 60 days. Example 2 : Submitted authorization request for a controlled medication has a prescription date of 01.12.2010 . However the related authorization request was submitted with a Date of Service of 5.12.2010. Hence authorization request will not be eligible for approval as prescription  validity for controlled medication prescriptions is 3 days.

Description: Authorization request overlaps or is within the period of another paid claim or approved authorization.
Examples/Descriptions: Authorization request has been submitted for home nursing while an approved request for inpatient stay already exist for the same encounter date. Hence the home nursing request would not be eligible for approval.

Description: Waiting period on pre-existing / specific conditions
Examples/Descriptions: Member policy effective date is 01.01.2011 and covers pre-existing  Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with 6 months waiting period, however authorization request submitted for inpatient admission effective on 01.02.2011, Hence service will not be eligible for approval unless pre-requisition of uninterrupted prior coverage with any health insurance plan is fulfilled.

Description: Service / Medication is above AED threshold
Benefit maximum for this time period or occurrence has been reached
Examples/Descriptions: Authorization requested for 6 Physiotherapy sessions but all eligible sessions have been exhausted; hence additional sessions will not be eligible for approval.

Description: Lifetime benefit maximum has been reached for this service/benefit category
Lifetime benefit maximum has been reached

Examples/Descriptions: Annual limit for a member is 250,000 AED and the cumulative paid amount exceeds this limit. Hence, all further services will not be not be eligible for payment.

Description: Authorization/Claim is a work-related injury/illness and thus the liability of the employer
Examples/Descriptions: Authorization request/Claim submitted with principal diagnosis "amputation of limb" and secondary diagnosis "adverse effects of work environment". In case work related injuries are not covered for the member, all services on the authorization request/claim will not be eligible for approval/payment . This code will be retired after 22 March 2011.

Description: Claim overlaps inpatient stay. Resubmit only those services rendered outside the inpatient stay
Examples/Descriptions: Pre-operative work up is done prior to Inpatient stay. Both the pre-operative work up and Inpatient stay are billed as one Inpatient encounter. The Pre-operative work up should be billed separately as an outpatient encounter to be eligible for payment.

Description: Date of birth follows the date of service
Examples/Descriptions: Member's date of birth is  02/01/2007. Claims submitted with services prior to this date will not be eligible for payment

Description: Date of death precedes the date of service
Examples/Descriptions: Claims submitted for an ECG with service date 02/01/2010, while date of death was on 01/01/2010 hence not eligible for payment.

Description: Inpatient admission spans multiple rate periods.  Resubmit separate claims
Examples/Descriptions: Member was admitted twice to the hospital; First authorized admission spans 01/01/2010 to 06/01/2010 and the second authorized admission from 08/01/201 through 16/01/2010. However the claim is submitted as a single Inpatient encounter for the period of 01/01/2010 and 16/01/2010. Thus the claim will not be eligible for payment unless submitted as two different encounters.

Description: Missing Service Codes in a DRG claim
Examples/Descriptions: The denial is used for DRG claims without the complete / expected complement of  Activity Lines. Example 1 : Inpatient DRG claim submitted with only the DRG code and CPTs without documenting the room type. Hence we cannot determine if the billing regime was correct. If long term services (per diem codes) were utilized then the claim cannot be submitted under the DRG billing regime.
A fee for service claim reported as a DRG claim. For Example in the case of Inpatient dental or Day care claims which should be billed as Fee For Service but are submitted as DRG claims.
